name: io.github.Dhruv123-123/interlock
description: A 100 ms judgment on every tool call: wraps any MCP server and gates tools/call with a plain-English Question Pack. Confirm asks the agent to justify; block refuses. Sensor: TypeSafe Jev, any OpenAI-compatible LLM, or rules only.

packageArguments.name: --task
packageArguments.description: What the agent has been asked to do; outside_task_scope is judged against it
Everything after this is the MCP server to wrap
The wrapped MCP server command and its arguments, e.g. npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem .

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter key; routes to TypeSafe Jev (typesafe/jev-1.13). Either this or JEV_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: JEV_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TypeSafe direct API key. Without any key only the rule-based (L0) checks run.

environmentVariables.name: INTERLOCK_FAIL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: open (default): forward calls if the sensor is unreachable; closed: refuse them
